tools.name: apply_generated_artwork
tools.description: Place an agent-generated HTTPS or data-URL image directly onto the visible greeting-card canvas with accessible alternative text.

imageUrl.description: An HTTPS image URL or image data URL.

tools.name: get_card_state
tools.description: Read the currently visible greeting card, recipient context, print format, artwork, price, and whether checkout requires human review.

tools.name: list_print_options
tools.description: List the actual supported card sizes, dimensions, individual print prices, and the available envelope colors.

tools.name: review_and_print
tools.description: Open the visible human-review checkpoint for the card and print price. Never submits payment, places an order, or prints without human confirmation.

tools.name: select_card_template
tools.description: Choose a visible starting canvas, including create-your-own for an empty card that the agent can populate with generated artwork and a personal message.

tools.name: set_card_design
tools.description: Update the card's visible paper color and accent color without replacing the agent-generated image or message.

backgroundColor.description: A CSS hex color, for example #f3e9df.

accentColor.description: A CSS hex color, for example #bb4f43.

tools.name: set_card_message
tools.description: Update the small cover label, the front message, or the inside message. Cover labels are limited to 56 characters, cover messages to 140, and inside messages to 420 so every supported print format remains legible.

eyebrowText.description: The small editable line above the main card-cover message.

tools.name: set_card_size
tools.description: Select a supported physical print size and portrait or landscape orientation, updating the visible preview and price.

tools.name: set_envelope
tools.description: Select the physical envelope color and optionally show or hide that envelope beside the live greeting-card preview.

tools.name: set_preview
tools.description: Show the front, inside, or back of the card and independently show or hide its selected envelope in the live preview.

tools.name: set_print_quantity
tools.description: Set the number of physical cards from 1 to 25 and immediately update the visible order total.

tools.name: set_recipient_context
tools.description: Bring the agent's knowledge of the recipient, relationship, occasion, memories, and desired tone into the visible card editor.

personalContext.description: A memory or detail the agent is authorized to use.

tools.name: start_custom_card
tools.description: Reset the visible card to the empty Create your own canvas while preserving recipient context, print size, envelope, and quantity.
